sample.title: Exposure Notification (Corona-Warn-App)
sample.description: The Rolling Proximity Identifier that a phone sends in one 10-minute interval, derived from its daily key.
sample.keywords: Corona, exposure notification, HKDF, AES, privacy

replacement.value: Change the interval number: every interval gives another identifier that cannot be linked to the others without the daily key.
